evidence.title: 观澜堂: 嘉庆二十四年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
evidence.date: 嘉庆二十四年 (1819), date from the compilation
evidence.excerpt_zh:
福海新波千顷宽，
堂开东岸对漪澜。金鳞映日轻霞漾，碧浪含风薄縠攒。和蔼韶光明远岫，微茫云影印遥滩。田功肇始仲春届，观我观民得大观。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 观澜堂, 1819, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 观澜堂: 嘉庆二十四年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
evidence.date: 嘉庆二十四年 (1819), date from the compilation
evidence.excerpt_zh: 八窗印晴晖，空明临碧沼。远岭写春霞，绮影绘天表。蓬岛水中央，金碧浮㵿渺。漪澜送暖飔，岸角迭环绕。昨岁驻渝关，沧溟观浩淼。心境养虚明，眼界随大小。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 观澜堂, 1819, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 观澜堂
evidence.locator: v3 p.14, under 接秀山房; source ref 7-161
evidence.excerpt_zh: 冰奁雪沼映银澜，堂挹虚明欣畅观。北峙群峰印云素，西排列岫染霞丹。境开琼岛心源澈，春满瑶京画幅宽。徒倚回廊舒远目，东风料峭不知寒。
evidence.summary: Poem 观澜堂 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1819, filed by the editors under 接秀山房.

evidence.title: 观澜堂
evidence.locator: v3 p.14, under 接秀山房; source ref 7-203
evidence.excerpt_zh: 堂临福海岸东偏，坐对晴澜得景全。远叠金鳞涵锦浪，平铺碧縠趁澄渊。霞烘遥渚涤余霭，风度繁林卷密烟。眼界无遮清旷极，又欣快澍润原田。
evidence.summary: Poem 观澜堂 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1819, filed by the editors under 接秀山房.

evidence.title: 观澜堂: 咸丰七年 poem of the Xianfeng Emperor
evidence.date: 咸丰七年 (1857), date from the compilation
evidence.excerpt_zh: 御苑东偏蓬岛南，山妆翠髻水拖蓝。连云远树分浓淡，点浪轻鸥见两三。鼓枻湖心波皛皛，停桡岸角柳毶毶。虚堂旷览足怡悦，霁景澄鲜上下含。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Xianfeng Emperor at 观澜堂, 1857, on boating. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 老北京的记忆(125): 涵虚朗鉴 and 接秀山房, quoting 《圆明园百景图志》
evidence.summary: Gives scene sizes and hall by hall measures: 涵虚朗鉴 200 x 60 m, 接秀山房 250 x 50 m. 接秀山房 became 观澜堂 in late Jiaqing. 1855 interior drawing at the NLC. Notes the names of the east-shore scenes were swapped around 1744, and that some modern plans mislabel the halls.

evidence.title: 圆明园福海东岸历史建筑方位考, 圆明园研究 78期
evidence.summary: Shows that plans disagree on which hall is which along the east shore of 福海: the 1936 Beiping survey, the 1979 He and Zeng plan and the 2010 百景图志 each label differently. Checking Yangshi Lei drawings and texts against the sites, it reads the surviving bases north to south as 贻兰亭, 会心不远, 寻云榭, 惠如春, 雷峰夕照, 临众芳, 云锦墅, 观澜堂. It notes no scientific dig has been done here.

evidence.title: 圆明园百景史事分景汇编: 观澜堂
evidence.summary: The compiler says 观鱼跃 was pulled down about 1817 for a new south-facing hall of five bays in three rolls, like 慎德堂 and the largest on 福海. 观澜堂: 13 dated items, 1819-1857, of which 13 poems (Jiaqing, Daoguang, Xianfeng); recurring themes: the view, boating, rain. First dated 1819, last dated 1857.

evidence.title: 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v3, editors' note on 接秀山房
evidence.summary: Begun 1731 on the south-east shore of 福海, a three-bay west-facing hall, with 琴趣轩, 寻云楼, 云锦墅, 澄练楼, 怡然书屋 and 揽翠亭 under Qianlong. Late Jiaqing replaced the main hall with five bays in three rolls, 观澜堂. The editors say that hall survived 1860, Cixi came in 1898, and it was lost around 1900.

evidence.title: 圆明园河道泊岸总平面图
evidence.date: 乾隆四十至四十九年, 嘉庆八至十六年间局部修改 (dating on the record)

evidence.title: 圆明园新证, 端木泓: dated additions shown on plan 1704
evidence.summary: Tables of when things were added, drawn from archives to date the plan's layers: 藻园 1752, 廓然大公 eight views 1754, 春雨轩 1755, 藏密楼 1758, 多稼轩 ten views 1759, 紫碧山房 1760, 安澜园 and 澄练楼 1763, 若帆之阁 1764, 汇万总春之庙 1769, 文源阁 1775, 法源楼 1779; after: 兰亭八柱 1779, 知过堂 1782, 课农轩 1816, 涵月楼 1827. The most useful single dating table found.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum, Historical Photographs of China, the Rijksmuseum, Wellcome and in NDL's albums of about 1900; today's photographs on Commons.

reconstructions.title: 《圆明园新证》: reading of Palace Museum plan No. 1704, stripped of its later paste-ups to the Qianlong layout of about 1779
reconstructions.why: Base sheet dated by listing what the plan shows against the Forty Scenes, poems and palace archives; paste-up layers and whited-out parts read separately for Jiaqing and Daoguang changes.
reconstructions.caveat: A reading of Qing plans, not a reconstruction.

reconstructions.title: 《一幅样式雷圆明园全图的年代推断》: NLC plan 043-001 dated by the outlines of scenes
reconstructions.why: Compares outlines on dated plans with archive dates of rebuilding; yellow labels that do not avoid the Daoguang taboo rule out a Daoguang date.
reconstructions.caveat: A reading of Qing plans, not a reconstruction.
